comparison.objective: Hook a carabiner onto a rod; candidate commissions a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Gate actuation and hook-to-rod placement versus recessed hex-key insertion, bimanual fine adjustment, locking, and guarded test operation.
comparison.success_condition: Carabiner must remain hooked on the rod; candidate requires two controlled stops and a drift-resistant locked setting. Setup and scoring fields are missing.
comparison.reason: Carabiner attachment is a latching/hooking operation, not iterative tuning and retention of a mechanical setting.
